subject.title: Cron allows invalid Feishu announce jobs without delivery.to, causing runtime delivery failure

question: Should maintainers adopt one of the two open fork PRs that close this issue, or close those candidates and queue a narrow replacement fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the repository already has two open conflicting fork PRs for the same fix, so automation should not choose or duplicate the landing path without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt one fork PR
options.body: Review the two open fork PRs and refresh the cleaner candidate into a focused gateway/service validation fix with regression coverage.

options.title: Close both and replace
options.body: Close the conflicting fork PRs, then queue a narrow replacement PR that preserves the issue evidence and credits the prior attempts.

options.title: Split UX follow-ups
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to create-time validation and file separate follow-ups for `cron audit --delivery` and clearer runtime diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Adopt one fork PR
recommendation.body: Review the two open fork PRs and refresh the cleaner candidate into a focused gateway/service validation fix with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest recent history signal on the cron gateway/service validation surface that should own the landing-path decision.
